name: D14 anonymous object/contact graph monitor evidence pilot
purpose: isolate whether object-centric relational inductive bias improves held-out continuous monitor evidence over the D13 ordered 61-D vector encoder
scope: combined D3+D12 TRAIN corpus only; DEV and TEST remain closed

representation.objects: three anonymous rigid-body nodes with shared weights
representation.node_channels: centred and gripper-relative position, vertical height, rotation6, linear/angular velocity, table/floor/robot contacts
representation.edges: all directed block pairs with relative position, distance, and pair-contact flag
representation.control: Cartesian targets relative to current gripper plus native gripper command
representation.readout: permutation-invariant node mean/max plus gripper token

outputs_and_loss.head: unchanged D13 joint amplitude/shape curves plus four direct continuous evidence values
outputs_and_loss.decision: inverse-transform and unchanged zero sign; no fitted threshold
outputs_and_loss.loss: evidence MSE plus the six unchanged equally weighted D9b amplitude/shape losses

decision.pass_both_axes: replicate seeds 2 and 3 before collecting upright-push TRAIN responses
decision.otherwise: stop; do not collect push data or tune against validation
